text.content:
Here's a controversial Talent that could be added to tier 4 Celestial Wizards, Ranaldans, and similar. It costs 500 XP to buy, and I add it here because, well, cats.

 

FATED

Max: 1

You are extraordinarily lucky. Perhaps the Gods have blessed you, or maybe you can somehow see the crackling skeins of fate spun by the Great Weaver itself. Gain +1 Fate Point.
